sahneler.metin: The most powerful rocket ever flown lifted off from Texas.
Less than four minutes later, it was destroyed.
Three engines failed to ignite at lift-off.
The blast damaged the launch pad.
Debris spread into a nearby state park.
SpaceX said it had expected to learn.
The pad had no flame diverters or water deluge system.

aciklama:
Starship IFT-1 was destroyed minutes after lift-off. The cause: a pad built without flame diverters or water deluge eroded by thrust, while engine failures crippled the vehicle.
